Store.Managed: 由启动器维护：在「设置」页改动后自动写回本文件。
Managed by the launcher: changes on the Settings page are written back here.
Store.Editable: 可以手工编辑，下次启动时读取；删掉的键会回落到默认值。
You may edit this by hand; it is read on the next start. Removed keys fall back to defaults.
Store.UnknownIgnored: 无法识别的行会被忽略，不会导致启动失败。
Unrecognised lines are ignored and never break startup.
Store.FontHint: embedded（软件默认）| system | 字体族名
embedded (app default) | system | font family name
Store.WindowHint1: # 上次退出时的窗口几何（物理像素，dpi = 96 即 100%）；
# Window geometry when the app last exited (physical pixels; dpi = 96 means 100%);
Store.WindowHint2: # remember_window = false 时不读取这段。
Store.WindowAbsent: # [window] 尚未记录：勾选「记住窗口位置」后正常退出一次即写入
# [window] not recorded yet: turn on "remember window position" and exit normally once
Store.TavernWindowHint1: # 酒馆桌面窗口上次关闭时的位置与大小（物理像素）；
# Position and size of the tavern desktop window when it last closed (physical pixels);
Store.TavernWindowHint2: # startup.remember_tavern_window = false 时不读取这段。
Store.TavernWindowAbsent: # [tavern_window] 尚未记录：桌面模式开关一次窗口即写入
# [tavern_window] not recorded yet: open and close the window once in desktop mode
Store.AutoLaunch: 登录 Windows 后自动启动
start automatically after signing in to Windows
Store.RememberTavernWindow: 桌面模式：下次打开回到上次关闭前的位置
desktop mode: reopen where it last closed
Store.WebViewMemory: WebView 内存上限（MB），最小 {0}，本机最大 {1}
WebView memory cap (MB); minimum {0}, this machine allows up to {1}
Store.ServerModeDerived: 由 startup.mode 推导，仅供阅读
Store.UserWhitelist: 普通 / 桌面模式的 IP 白名单，逗号分隔；服务器模式的白名单由服务范围推导，不写在这里
IP whitelist for normal and desktop mode, comma separated; in server mode it follows the service scope and is not written here
Store.GithubAcceleration: 所有 GitHub 链接是否走 gh-proxy.org 加速（同时写入全局 git insteadOf 规则）
whether GitHub links go through gh-proxy.org acceleration (also writes the global git insteadOf rule)
Store.ExportPath: 资源导出目录（可用环境变量）
